name: McPherson Media Internet
summary: Shepparton ISP arm of the Shepparton News publisher (dialup, from 1995); ISP arm wound down (MCPHERSON NEWSPAPERS PROPRIETARY LIMITED, ACN 004 522 794).

events.details: ISP arm wound down. The McMedia/McPherson Media ISP identity died when mcmedia.com.au rebranded to Goulburn Valley Telco between Aug 2016 and Feb 2017.

refs.label: Aug 2016 still fully McMedia/McPherson Media branded retail telco site
By 4 Feb 2017 the site had become Goulburn Valley Telco (Bendigo Telco group)
ABN history shows the McMedia business name dropped in 2017
ABR: MCPHERSON NEWSPAPERS PROPRIETARY LIMITED ACN 004 522 794
